checks.name: default_planning_permission
checks.detail: Owner may save bounded planning records from task start without per-note approval.

checks.name: implementation_boundary
checks.detail: The planning exception grants documentation only; implementation and other side effects retain approval.

checks.name: explicit_restrictions
checks.detail: Explicit user/role/runtime restrictions override default document permission.

checks.name: existing_record_mechanism
checks.detail: Existing task-record mechanism retained; meaningful revisions and decision history are preserved.

checks.name: meaningful_updates
checks.detail: Notes cover meaningful requirement changes, revisions, decisions/approval evidence and unresolved questions.

checks.name: no_new_tracker_or_log
checks.detail: No transcript dump, new parallel tracker, compulsory ADR or per-message record.

checks.name: stale_conflicts_removed
checks.detail: Blanket chat-only planning restrictions removed from affected active instructions.

checks.name: native_metadata_and_ownership
checks.detail: Three TOML files parse; names/descriptions/native metadata and shared-record/read-only responsibilities unchanged. Claude frontmatter unchanged.

checks.name: skill_discovery_metadata
checks.detail: Existing skill names/descriptions unchanged; instruction body synchronization only, not native discovery proof.

checks.name: fresh_adoption_values
checks.detail: Blank adoption fields/values remain unchanged; documentation permission does not invent product or implementation authority.

checks.name: package_integrity
checks.detail: PASS: inventory hashes, mirror bytes, 17 skills per root; 3 original / 23 adapted upstream files

checks.name: diff_and_whitespace
checks.detail: git diff --check and whitespace inspection include untracked task documentation.

checks.name: git_scope_unchanged
checks.detail: No branch, commit, staging or publication operation performed in this task.

checks.name: journal_and_source_identity
checks.detail: Schema-v1 record preserves actual pre-edit skill fingerprint and null unavailable measurements; no duplicate prior-task event.

content_review_cases: Planning before implementation approval may save bounded meaningful notes.
Explicit read-only/no-file instruction prohibits saving, including journals.
Application/config/agent-rule changes remain outside the planning-only exception.
Read-only children return proposed shared-record changes to the owner.
Draft/superseded/unknown states and actual human sources stay distinct.
Short tasks do not create empty records per message.
limitations: Content review cases are source analysis, not executed native agent behavior.
Native/cross-session behavior NOT_RUN; no independent reviewer or publication.
